title: Crochet STAR BABY Tutorial · Amigurumi Waldorf Doll
description:
This step-by-step crochet tutorial will teach you how to crochet STAR BABY! This is a Waldorf-inspired amigurumi doll that is low-sew and takes about 1 hour 40 minutes for an experienced crocheter to complete from start the finish. The only sewing needed is to attach the hat to the head. 

Want a written pattern? See "PATTERN LINKS" below to download the ad-free written PDF pattern with 40+ photo references. Thank you for supporting me as a pattern designer!

13:59 Tummy Circle

47:42 Finished Look

----- About the Pattern -----
Star Baby is a Waldorf-inspired crochet doll that is low-sew and quick to work up. It features a cute baby in a star shaped outfit, including a cone hat. The arms and legs of the doll are soft and unstuffed, making it a cuddly snuggler especially if made using plush yarn. Customize it in many ways, such as crocheting hair (instructions included in pattern), adding a rattle or crinkle sheet in the body as a baby toy, embroidering facial features like a nose or smile, and adding blush to the cheeks. 

This doll makes a sweet baby shower gift or gift for an infant or newborn, as long as the eyes are embroidered to avoid choking hazard.  The Star Baby also works well as a birthday gift or Christmas stocking stuffer for young children.  You can make it for craft fairs and markets too. 

The PDF pattern includes lots of photo references to guide you through the doll-making process. 

TIME
1 hr 40 min for an experienced crocheter 
Note: My testers reported taking between 1 hour 20 minutes to 2 hours to complete this doll. 

SIZE
Approximately 8” tall, 6” wide

MATERIALS
Bulky weight 5 yarn in desired colors (I used this: https://lionbrand.sjv.io/rakQrQ)
5mm crochet hook (My fav: https://amzn.to/40o0K7M)
7mm crochet hook (My fav: https://amzn.to/40o0K7M)
8mm black safety eyes (https://amzn.to/3FW8er2)
Stuffing
Yarn needle
Scissors
Optional: Small rattle and/or crinkle insert.
Optional: Medium weight 4 yarn and a 2.75mm hook for the hair

LEVEL
★★★☆☆ Intermediate. Requires familiarity with stitches used (below) and attaching yarn.

STITCHES USED (US TERMS) 
FO = fasten off
ch = chain
sl st = slip stitch
sc = single crochet
inc = increase (insert 2 sc in same st)
dec = decrease (sc 2 sts together)
dc = double crochet
